originalTitle: The White House says Truth Social is the ‘most powerful and popular social media platform in the world’

content: The White House claims the Donald Trump-owned Truth Social is the “most powerful and popular social media platform in the world.” The statement, provided to The New York Times by White House spokesperson Davis Ingle, is at odds with the user counts from some of the biggest social media platforms on the web. Data gathered by Search Engine Land shows YouTube is the most popular platform in the world, with 2.65 billion monthly active users. Facebook comes in second with 2.39 billion active users around the globe, followed by TikTok with 2.21 billion and Instagram with 1.99 billion. Truth Social doesn’t make Search Engine Land’s top 10 list, which shows Elon Musk’s X and Meta’s Threads at the bottom with 450 million and 223 million users, respectively. Even those platforms trail Pinterest, which is listed with 579 million global users.  Truth Social’s traffic appears to be declining. As reported by the NYT, data from Similarweb suggests that the number of monthly visitors to Truth Social dipped 36 percent in July compared to the same time last year. From January to July 2025, an average of 28 million people visited Truth Social each month, while this number fell to 25 million during the first seven months of 2026, according to the NYT. Last month, Truth Social launched its $100,000 / month subscription to gain early access to posts from Trump and other prominent users, raising concerns about corruption. The NYT report details Trump’s posting patterns on Truth Social, which often include AI-generated images, such as one showing his head on Hulk Hogan’s body and another hitting a cut-out of Iran with a hammer brandishing the American flag. Ingle cites President Trump’s “authentic voice” as the reason for the platform’s so-called popularity, adding it’s where “he communicates directly with the American people and the world without the biased media taking him out of context.”
chineseTitle: 白宫称 Truth Social 是“世界上最强大、最受欢迎的社交媒体平台”
chineseSummary: 白宫声称唐纳德·特朗普旗下的 Truth Social 是“世界上最强大、最受欢迎的社交媒体平台”。白宫发言人戴维斯·英格尔向《纽约时报》提供的这份声明与一些最大的网络社交媒体平台的用户数量不一致。收集的数据[...]
chineseContent: 白宫声称唐纳德·特朗普旗下的 Truth Social 是“世界上最强大、最受欢迎的社交媒体平台”。白宫发言人戴维斯·英格尔向《纽约时报》提供的这份声明与一些最大的网络社交媒体平台的用户数量不一致。 Search Engine Land 收集的数据显示，YouTube 是全球最受欢迎的平台，每月活跃用户达 26.5 亿。 Facebook 以 23.9 亿全球活跃用户位居第二，其次是 TikTok（22.1 亿）和 Instagram（19.9 亿）。 Truth Social 并未进入 Search Engine Land 的前 10 名名单，其中埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 X 和 Meta 的 Threads 排名垫底，分别拥有 4.5 亿和 2.23 亿用户。即使这些平台也落后于拥有 5.79 亿全球用户的 Pinterest。  Truth Social 的流量似乎正在下降。据《纽约时报》报道，Similarweb 的数据显示，7 月份 Truth Social 的月访问量与去年同期相比下降了 36%。据《纽约时报》报道，从 1 月到 2025 年 7 月，平均每月有 2800 万人访问 Truth Social，而这一数字在 2026 年前 7 个月下降至 2500 万人。上个月，Truth Social 推出了每月 10 万美元的订阅服务，以便尽早访问特朗普和其他知名用户的帖子，引发了人们对腐败的担忧。 《纽约时报》的报道详细介绍了特朗普在 Truth Social 上的发布模式，其中通常包括人工智能生成的图像，例如一张将他的头放在绿巨人霍根的尸体上，另一张用挥舞着美国国旗的锤子敲击伊朗的切口。英格尔引用特朗普总统的“真实声音”作为该平台所谓受欢迎的原因，并补充说这是“他沟通的地方”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
